Subject: Discovery follow-up — align on trial timeline & technical deep dive

Hi Liam (and Sabrina),

Thanks again for the time today — enjoyed learning more about how MedPath routes clinical notes and what 'good' looks like for search relevance and triage suggestions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your trial started:

- What we heard: ingest via S3 + nightly batch, priority on precision for triage flags, latency target ~200ms p50 for retrieval calls.
- Proposed next meeting: 60-min technical deep dive + trial charter alignment (owners, data slices, success metrics, prompt set you want us to validate).
- Prep ask: can you share 2–3 example patient note types (redacted) and a short list of success criteria (precision/recall thresholds or business KPIs)?

Availability: Ben (our solutions lead) and Neha (PM for trials) are copied. Can you do any of these slots (PT)?
- Thu Jul 1 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Fri Jul 2 — 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

If those don't work, tell us two windows that do and we will accommodate. I'll draft a one-page trial charter after we agree on a time.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a short hands-on trial.

Best,
Rachel

1) Success criteria — at a minimum we want to measure: precision@10 for triage suggestions, latency under 250ms p50 for retrieval, and a runbook for false positives during the pilot window.
2) Data samples — I can surface two de-identified note examples by end of day today (redacted). Would you like them sent to this thread or uploaded to a secure S3 location?
